prompt:
Design an expressive iOS/macOS Weather widget for a desktop dashboard. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. Never repeat a row or value.

Compositions (distinct surfaces, palettes & motion):
1 Storm Canvas: Full-bleed dark storm sky with drifting clouds; top-left giant temp + "Madrid, Spain ↗"; top-right condition; bottom 3-slot hourly strip with filled blue rain/yellow sun icons.
2 Navy Split: Deep navy (#0F172A) card with rain shimmer; 2-column split—left has "Today / London" at top and huge temp + H/L at bottom; right stacks 5 forecast rows with icon + H/L pairs.
3 Cobalt Stack: Vibrant blue (#0A7AFF) card with radial sun glow; duotone badge, bold white labels, and pill temp bars with white dots.
4 Bento Cards: White (#FFFFFF) card with soft grey (#F2F2F7) inset sub-cards holding a circular humidity ring and blue wind bar chart.
5 Dot-Matrix Teal: Teal (#178582) card with a top 3x10 dot-matrix rain grid (pulsing white/yellow lit dots vs dim), city header, and huge bottom temp.

Hard content limits per size:
Small: city, filled icon, hero temp (44px+), condition, plus ONE detail (H/L, ring, or dot-grid). Max 5 items. No hourly or daily rows.
Medium: Small's content plus ONE block: 3-slot hourly row, 5-row right forecast stack, or 2 grey sub-cards.
Large: Medium's content plus ONE more block: 5-day range-bar list or 2x2 Bento metric grid.
Never squeeze larger content into a smaller size.

Spacing & Visual: 24px squircle; padding 16px Small, 20px Medium/Large; 8px grid, 12px+ group gaps, no clipping. Hero temp 44px+ on Small, other text 11-14px (never <11px), smooth motion. Believable data.
designSpec: Five distinct weather families each render once at Small, Medium and Large, with fixed-size surfaces, 24px corners, filled weather glyphs and size-appropriate content blocks. Photography, rain-like texture, radial sunlight, inset metrics and a 3×10 dot matrix provide expressive static atmospheric cues without unsupported animation. All forecasts are clearly labeled synthetic, and the fifteen hero temperatures are distinct.
